differences.title: 1. CORE LANGUAGE
differences.leftDesc: Leverages Rust's memory safety and performance for efficient compilation and plugin development, offering strong type guarantees and concurrency primitives.
differences.rightDesc: Utilizes Go's concurrency features and fast compilation for rapid builds. Its garbage collector manages memory, providing simplicity for developers.

differences.title: 2. COMPILATION SPEED
differences.leftDesc: Rspack compiles modules in parallel using Rust's async capabilities and thread pools, minimizing build times by fully utilizing multi-core processors.
differences.rightDesc: esbuild executes tasks concurrently using goroutines, achieving impressive build speeds through efficient task scheduling and I/O handling.

differences.title: 3. PLUGIN SYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Aims for high compatibility with existing Webpack plugins, allowing easier migration and reuse of the vast Webpack ecosystem.
differences.rightDesc: Offers a straightforward API for custom transformations and integrations, prioritizing ease of use for common bundling tasks.

differences.title: 4. MEMORY USAGE
differences.leftDesc: Rust's compile-time memory management leads to predictable and often lower memory footprints during complex builds and large projects.
differences.rightDesc: Go's garbage collector can sometimes introduce pauses or higher memory usage, though it simplifies development by automating memory management.

differences.title: 5. DEVELOPMENT SERVER
differences.leftDesc: Integrates robust HMR capabilities, rebuilding only changed modules and preserving application state for a seamless developer experience.
differences.rightDesc: Provides extremely fast HMR updates by recompiling only necessary code segments, significantly speeding up the feedback loop.

differences.title: 6. TARGET ECOSYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Built on Webpack's established foundations, Rspack targets compatibility with a broad range of existing tools and configurations.
differences.rightDesc: Primarily designed for modern JavaScript and TypeScript projects, focusing on speed and simplicity for current web development needs.

differences.title: 7. COMMUNITY & SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: As a newer project, Rspack is rapidly growing its community and feature set, with strong backing from ByteDance.
differences.rightDesc: esbuild has widespread adoption and a large, active community, benefiting from extensive testing and contributions.
